title: Entralink records
description: The Entralink roguelike's records (docs/paperwhite2/design/entralink-roguelike-prototype.md, "Records"; tools/paperwhite2/entralink_records.py). The Nightmare codex records every species with "pokedex": false (the forest's Nightmares, in every form) and the special forms listed here, which the records also show in a list of their own.

black_ranks.description: The Entree's Black Tree ranks: the Dream Shards earned in all (whatever was spent) that reach ranks 1 to 5, each above the one before

white_milestones.description: The milestones that count for the Entree's White Tree rank, each reached raising it by one in any order: beat_final (the final room beaten, Darkrai), catch_all (every catchable enemy of the rooms caught), fill_codex (every Nightmare species and special form met), shop_cap (the hub shop's picks bought up to its cap), all_rooms (every room of rooms/ entered)

special_forms.description: The forest-only forms counted as Special: a species and one of its forms, each met, beaten and caught counted alone

form.description: Its form, below the species' form count

rewards.description: What the Entree's ranks unlock: each reward's tree and rank (1 to 5; 0 unlocks it from the start)

reserve_box.description: The hub's Reserve Box NPC (the PC and the Reserve Box), hidden below its rank

hub_shop.description: The hub's buff shop NPC (blue and purple picks for Dream Shards), hidden below its rank

buff_room.description: Every run's first room is a buff room (the buff template)

dust_bonus.description: Battles give dust_bonus percent more Dream Dust

shard_bonus.description: A run's end gives shard_multiplier times its Dream Shards

difficulty.description: The hub's difficulty NPC (a placeholder: difficulty tiers are coming), hidden below its rank

fog.description: The hub's fog NPC, which sets the hub's fog (pink, purple, black or none), hidden below its rank

shard_shop.description: The hub's item shop NPC, selling shard_shop's items for Dream Shards into the real bag, hidden below its rank

skip_round.description: Starting a run asks whether to skip round 1: skip_round's buff picks and Dream Dust, then round 2's first room

form_change.description: The hub's form NPC, which changes a party Pokémon of a special form's species to that form and back, hidden below its rank

dust_bonus.description: The dust_bonus reward: the percent more Dream Dust a battle gives

shard_multiplier.description: The shard_bonus reward: how many times its Dream Shards a run's end gives

skip_round.description: The skip_round reward's head start, in place of round 1

picks.description: The buff picks, each from an offer of round 1's, chosen as after a battle

shard_shop.description: The shard_shop reward's goods: items for use outside the forest, sold for Dream Shards into the real bag (the Poké Mart's screen)

tree.description: The tree whose rank unlocks it

rank.description: The rank that unlocks it (0: from the start)
